title: Invariance of product weight under reindexing
statement: Let $I$ and $K$ be finite sets, let $e:I\\to K$ be a bijection, let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb{R}$, and assign one of the states free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$ to each element of $I$. The product of the corresponding coordinate weights is unchanged when the assignment is transported to $K$ along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each element of $I$
